info.title: Meta-Game Service
info.description:
Meta-game service scaffold (BYOSnap). Exposes only enough surface to prove the two connectivity paths — client → gateway → service (`/ping`) and service → snap over internal gRPC (`/snap-check`) — plus the platform health probe. No meta-game features (quests, economy, offers) live here yet.

Authentication: each operation declares `x-snapser-auth-types` (user|api-key|internal). Operations that also set `x-snapser-auth-passthrough: true` are public — the gateway does not require a session token. Only `/health` is public. Identity is the gateway-stamped `User-Id` header: the gateway validates the session token and injects the header, and the service trusts it (no self-rolled auth). Requests arriving without it (possible for api-key/internal callers, or locally where there is no gateway) receive 401 unless the caller self-stamps `User-Id`.

tags.name: Connectivity
tags.description: Connectivity-proof endpoints for the two BYOSnap paths

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe. Always returns 200 when the process is up. Used as the BYOSnap readiness probe path; also served unprefixed (outside the gateway base path) for the platform probe.
Proves client → gateway → service connectivity: echoes the gateway-stamped `User-Id` header back to the caller along with the service build version. 401 when the header is absent.

200.description: Authenticated round trip; `userId` is the gateway-stamped identity

get.description: Proves service → snap connectivity over internal gRPC: makes one read-only `auth.AuthService/GetUser` call for the requesting user against the Auth snap (addressed via the platform-injected `SNAPEND_AUTH_GRPC_URL`, with `SNAPEND_INTERNAL_HEADER` attached as `gateway` call metadata) and reports the round-trip duration and upstream status.

502.description: Upstream call failed; `upstream` carries the gRPC status text (or an unconfigured note when `SNAPEND_AUTH_GRPC_URL` is unset)

userId.description: The gateway-stamped User-Id header, echoed back

upstream.description: "OK" on success; otherwise the gRPC status text (code: message)
